groups.contract: Native selected numeric aliases, grid casts and basis construction preserve port prerequisites
groups.disposition: Complete314-line pinned body personally read. Real/Int/Vector aliases select f32/i32 or f64/i64 and2D/3D; fixed DIM*2 is at most6. Integer-to-float loses precision at large grid indices, float-to-int native casts saturate/truncate and NaN collapses0; neither is checked coordinate/grid admission. orthonormal_subspace_basis checks empty then normalizes first input and returns forZERO, chooses a nonparallel branch, emits at most two vectors respecting first callbackfalse. It intentionally implements documented3D one-vector case; multiple-vector/null/nonfinite meaning remains actual native caller dependency, not a promoted ordinary wrong-basis defect. No arbitrary epsilon or signed lattice restrictions imposed.

groups.contract: Native cuboid construction/scaling and feature operations do not establish bespoke physical admission
groups.disposition: Complete783-line pinned body personally read; latter large ConvexPolyhedron block is commented evidence, not executable behavior. Cuboid::new copies raw public half_extents despite positive prose; scaled multiplies raw scale and can invert/overflow. Actual Avian adapter273 passes abs(scale), which closes negative-scale inversion on that path but not overflow/zero/NaN without producer admission. Feature support picks axes0..DIM-1, fixedmod2/3 and copysign±1 justify table indexes and small ID arithmetic. feature_normal Face(id) indexes unbounded publicid minus dimension with no range guard; arbitrary raw out-of-range Face can panic. Exact packed face-ID producer/receiver relation and first-party call remain unproved, so no ordinary collision normal failure promoted. Native vertex/edge normals normalize fixed small ±1 vectors; no independent finite-extreme numerator there. Preserve native support shape topology and actual packed ID ownership; no duplicate game-level feature-ID wrapper invented.

groups.contract: Shared shape mutation is copy-on-write; constructors retain fallible versus raw native behavior
groups.disposition: Complete715-line pinned body personally read. make_mut prepares clone_dyn if Arc not unique, replaces ownedArc then get_mut unwrap under unique-return contract; mutation of one shared clone does not intentionally mutate other clones. Primitive constructors delegate raw values; cuboid wrapper is not positive/finite admission. Trimesh allocates/publishes SharedShape only after native TriMesh::new/with_flags returnsOk, retaining native error. Hull and convex_mesh use Option; convex decomposition filters failed part constructors before compound publication, so success does not certify original all-parts completeness. Voxels/VHACD and Array2 heightfield delegate actual count/geometry/work policy with no local checks; no concrete first-party oversized/native-invalid body asserted. SharedShape Serialize delegates typed native shape, Deserialize rejects unsupported custom shape explicitly rather than manufacturing fallback. Codec leaf/admission semantics remain actual typed-shape dependency. No shape allocation, geometry generation, Serde roundtrip, physics or tests executed.
